items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: there were two trombone sounds, Tommy Dorsey and Jack Teagarden, one or the other.

ctx.x: Well, sure. Well, he was probably the most imitated guy during that short period of his career of anyone in the whole trombone scene standard. He was the next big
move after.-- and until Bill showed up on the scene, as far as I was concerned, there were two trombone sounds, Tommy Dorsey and Jack Teagarden, one or the other.
And he was the first person to come along, to me, that had a whole different sound. He didn't sound like either of them.
